contact.basis: Interpolated provider elevation at the published site anchor.

method: Bilinear interpolation of the original Mapzen RGB terrain tiles over the larger 512 m collection frame. The ground is left unmodified.
limitations: The served tile spacing and the 2 m review grid can oversample the native elevation product. Footing heights and fine masonry grades need local estimates.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles and open elevation source providers
